background.name: Ivory Off-White
background.usage: Primary background for all sections, providing a warm, spacious, gallery-like feel.

text_primary.name: Charcoal
text_primary.usage: Headings, primary body text, ensuring high contrast without the harshness of pure black.

accent_primary.name: Muted Bronze / Warm Gold
accent_primary.usage: Hover states, active slider handles, delicate UI borders, and small accent typography (overlines).

accent_secondary.name: Natural Beige
accent_secondary.usage: Soft secondary backgrounds, bento grid block backgrounds, and subtle hover highlights.

stone_tone.name: Stone Tone
stone_tone.usage: Borders, inactive states, timeline vertical lines.

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large quotes. Never use bold; rely on scale and light weights for elegance.

body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, button text, and descriptions.

layout_blueprints.layout: Fixed top, w-full, z-50. Minimalist transparent nav that transforms on scroll (adds backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border-stone_tone/20). Left: Wordmark Logo. Right: Clean text links + 'Start Project' CTA.

h-[200vh] relative. Uses a sticky container (h-screen) with overflow-hidden. A wide panorama image acts as the background. As the user scrolls down, the image translates horizontally (e.g., from 0% to -30%) using Framer Motion to simulate panning a camera across the room. Overlay text: Huge 'Cormorant Garamond' headline centered, bottom-anchored scroll indicator.
Massive typography block. text-4xl md:text-6xl max-w-4xl mx-auto text-center. Staggered word-by-word reveal on scroll using Framer Motion.

Cinematic horizontal scroll. A sticky container with an inner track that moves horizontally. Each project is a large card (w-[80vw] md:w-[60vw]) with high-quality interior images. Minimal text overlay at the bottom corner of each image.

Editorial vertical list. A group of border-b (border-stone_tone/30) list items. Large text (text-3xl md:text-5xl). On hover, a floating image corresponding to the service appears and follows the cursor (or fades in fixed to the right side if cursor follow is too complex).
Asymmetrical Bento Grid (Tetris Grid). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix of large imagery, large typography statistics (e.g., '15+ Years'), and soft Natural Beige background blocks.
Vertical timeline. A single vertical line drawn down the left side. As user scrolls, steps (1 to 4) fade in and slide up. Step numbers use the primary accent color.
Interactive juxtaposition component. Two overlapping images with a custom drag handle. Muted bronze handle with arrows. Allows users to slide and see the transformation.
Editorial layout. A large quote taking up most of the screen. 'Cormorant Garamond' italicized. Next/Prev minimal buttons to cycle through stories.
Full screen (h-screen). Dark overlay on a premium interior image. Large text 'Ready to transform your space?' and a minimalist button.

Minimalist form. Two-column grid for inputs (Name, Email), full width for message. Inputs are bottom-border only (border-b border-charcoal/30), floating labels. No heavy boxes. Includes basic form validation and a submit button that indicates loading state.
py-24. Large 'SUNTEK' typographic logo taking full width. Links distributed in 3 columns above it. Very clean, minimal.

motion_patterns.smooth_scroll: Lenis (if possible) or CSS scroll-behavior: smooth. Framer motion useScroll for linked animations.
motion_patterns.reveal_up: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40 }}, whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}, transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
motion_patterns.parallax_image: scale image slightly and translate Y opposite to scroll direction
motion_patterns.horizontal_scroll: useTransform on x axis mapped to container scrollYProgress
motion_patterns.hover_button: arrow icon translates right slightly, border color transitions to Muted Bronze

hero_panorama.usage: Background for the immersive scroll-controlled hero section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use generic SaaS layouts. Build this purely as a high-end editorial marketing site.
Install and use lucide-react for all standard icons, unless explicitly asked for other libraries.

Use Framer Motion to create a horizontal scroll effect for the 'Immersive Hero' panorama and 'Selected Projects' sections. The hero should scroll the background image horizontally on vertical scroll to simulate a 360-degree camera pan.
For typography, explicitly set Google Fonts via next/font (if Next.js) or standard import for 'Cormorant Garamond' (serif) and 'Outfit' (sans-serif). Do not use Inter.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on their role.
All JS code must be pure .jsx / .js - do NOT generate .tsx or TS types.
Avoid typical card borders/shadows. Rely on massive spacing, negative space, and large typography to define layout.
Use standard HTML inputs with Tailwind for the contact form to achieve the 'bottom border only' look, or deeply customize shadcn's Input component to strip out default rings and borders.
